Package com.sicomsa.dmt.util

Class QueryBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.sicomsa.dmt.util.QueryBuilder
public class QueryBuilder extends Object
Builds queries for emitted and received certificates as of SAT's download web service version 1.5

You can reuse this builder. It will retain properties set even after each build, or you can build and reset it to clear all properties.

Important: When requesting CFDI type of download set EstadoComprobante "Vigente", to avoid a response error, since SAT will not allow to download canceled CFDI's. You can set to EstadoComprobante "Todos", if your choice of download is Metadata.

Examples:

 
      String rfc = "RFC SOLICITANTE"; //Valid RFC expected here

      //We want to make emitted an received dowload queries for this rfc
      //from 2020-06-01 to 2020-06-15.
      //Properties set on this builder will remain until changed.
      QueryBuilder builder =
          new QueryBuilder()
              .setRfcSolicitante(rfc)
              .setFechaInicial(QueryMap.dayStart(2020, 6, 1))
              .setFechaFinal(QueryMap.dayEnd(2020, 6, 15));

      //We use previous builder with defaults set and set properties
      //for emitted certificates
      //Note: since we are going to request download CFDI type we must
      //      set state of certificate to "Vigente", to avoid getting an
      //      error from SAT since we can not download cancelled CFDIs
      Query emitidos = builder
          .setRfcEmisor(rfc)
          .setTipoSolicitud(QueryBuilder.TIPO_CFDI)
          .setEstadoComprobante(QueryBuilder.ESTADO_VIGENTE)
          .buildEmitidosQuery(); //we use this method for emitted certificates

      //We set an empty String("") instead of null to RfcEmisor property if we
      //want the received certificate from "any" emisor.
      //Since we are downloading Metadata we can also request canceled certificates,
      //so we set "Todos" in certificate state.
      //We do not need to set period or rfc emisor, since we alreade set them
      Query recibidos = builder
          .setRfcEmisor("")
          .setTipoSolicitud(QueryBuilder.TIPO_METADATA)
          .setEstadoComprobante(QueryBuilder.ESTADO_TODOS)
          .buildRecibidosQuery(rfc); //we use this method for received certificates
 
      //For download requests by Id we use FolioQueryBuilder
      Query folio = new FolioQueryBuilder()
          .setFolio("C1FFD659-6E3A-XXXX-9DDD-TTTT96B2471")
          .setRfcSolicitante(rfc)
          .build();
QueryBuilder is not thread safe.

    • buildEmitidosQuery

      public ExtendedQuery buildEmitidosQuery(List<String> receptorsList)
      Returns an ExtendedQuery to request emitted certificates to the specific rfc receptors included in the received list; build from the attributes set to this builder.
      Parameters:
      receptorsList - list of rfc receptors that certificates were emmited to. It can be null or empty, which will mean emitted to "any" rfc receptor.
      Returns:
      ExtendedQuery to request emitted certificates to the specific rfc receptors included in the received list; build from the attributes set to this builder

    • buildRecibidosQuery

      public ExtendedQuery buildRecibidosQuery(String rfcReceptor)
      Returns an ExtendedQuery to request the certificates the specified rfc receptor received.
      Parameters:
      rfcReceptor - rfc of the receiver of certificates. This is a required query parameter by SAT, when requesting received certificates .
      Returns:
      ExtendedQuery to request the certificates the specified rfc receptor received
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if rfcReceptor is null or empty
